title: Infrastructure monitoring overview — Pulsegrid (DevOps)
notes: v2 re-implements the console with styled-components. The horizontal top nav becomes a left sidebar (Incidents moves up; a hidden mobile tab bar repeats the links) and the environment select moves into the sidebar header. Each service tile becomes a <service-tile> web component with its own declarative shadow root, sorted by status (down, degraded, healthy). The incident banner turns into a callout inside the page with a <button> instead of a link; a hidden incident drawer repeats 'Join war room'. Alerts are re-sorted by severity, get ULID ids, two new alerts are inserted, 'Acknowledge' becomes 'Ack' and the silence button is wrapped in a tooltip trigger with a new aria-label. On-call moves into an <oncall-card> shadow root.
